scope: BPI Phase 1 shadow-batch vertical slice only

items.operation: Reject candidate evidence without eventTime before persistence
items.evidence: Bean validation rejected the malformed evidence and the tenant inbox count remained zero.

items.operation: Ingest a batch candidate with a real signed internal JWT
items.evidence: Candidate persisted as PENDING at revision 1 under JWT tenant, plant and line claims.

items.operation: Replay the identical candidate event
items.evidence: The replay returned the same candidate ID; candidate and inbox counts remained one.

items.operation: Reuse the eventId with a different candidateKey and changed payload checksum
items.evidence: application/problem+json conflict returned with a traceId; no additional inbox or candidate row persisted.

items.operation: Confirm a candidate without Idempotency-Key and If-Match
items.evidence: The command was rejected before persistence.

items.operation: Confirm a candidate and create an audited shadow batch
items.evidence: Candidate became CONFIRMED at revision 2; batch was shadow=true and wmsStatus=NOT_REQUESTED.

items.operation: Replay the confirmation command with the same idempotency key
items.evidence: Idempotent-Replay=true and the original batch ID were returned without duplicate persistence.

items.operation: Reject a candidate without Idempotency-Key and If-Match
items.evidence: The rejection was denied before command persistence.

items.operation: Reject a false candidate without creating a shadow batch
items.evidence: Candidate became REJECTED at revision 2 with reviewer and reason; audit action was CANDIDATE_REJECTED from revision 1 to 2.

items.operation: Replay the rejection with the same idempotency key
items.evidence: Idempotent-Replay=true returned the original REJECTED candidate without another audit or state transition.

items.operation: Confirm a rejected candidate from a stale page
items.evidence: The stale confirmation returned currentRevision=2 and its transaction left no idempotency row.

items.operation: Reuse a completed rejection key for candidate confirmation
items.evidence: Method and resource_path were revalidated with the checksum; the rejection response could not be replayed through the confirmation endpoint.

items.operation: Verify rejection does not create batch facts
items.evidence: All three marker-scoped row counts remained zero after rejection and idempotent replay.

items.operation: Replay a completed idempotent command with a token that no longer covers the candidate line
items.evidence: Object scope was rechecked before the cached idempotent response could be returned.

items.operation: Confirm with a new idempotency key and stale If-Match revision
items.evidence: currentRevision=2 was returned; the transaction rolled back and did not persist an additional idempotency row.

items.operation: Read the shadow batch, boundary evidence and state timeline
items.evidence: The response contained shadow=true, one start evidence item and SHADOW_BATCH_CREATED in the timeline.

items.operation: Read a candidate with the same tenant but an unauthorized line claim
items.evidence: Object-level line authorization denied access.

items.operation: Read a candidate with a different tenant claim
items.evidence: Cross-tenant access returned not found and did not disclose object existence.

items.operation: Run a command after removing the tenant line override for bpi.commands
items.evidence: The request inherited the global bpi.commands=false flag and was denied before command persistence.

items.operation: Suspend an ACTIVE batch without command headers
items.evidence: The batch remained ACTIVE at revision 1 and no command row was written.

items.operation: Suspend automatic processing for an ACTIVE batch
items.evidence: The batch became SUSPENDED at revision 2 with BATCH_SUSPENDED state and audit events; current line status was BLOCKED and remained visible in onlyAbnormal overview.

items.operation: Replay the completed suspension with the same key
items.evidence: Idempotent-Replay=true returned the original SUSPENDED revision 2 response without another event.

items.operation: Reuse the suspension key through the resume endpoint
items.evidence: Resource path and checksum validation prevented a suspension response from being replayed as resume.

items.operation: Suspend a batch that is already SUSPENDED
items.evidence: currentRevision=2 was returned and the failed command transaction left no idempotency row.

items.operation: Resume with stale If-Match revision 1
items.evidence: currentRevision=2 was returned and the failed command transaction rolled back.

items.operation: Resume automatic processing for a SUSPENDED batch
items.evidence: The batch returned to ACTIVE at revision 3 with BATCH_RESUMED state and audit events; current line status returned to RUNNING and left onlyAbnormal overview.

items.operation: Directly verify final batch state, ordered state events, audits and idempotency rows
items.evidence: Final state was ACTIVE|3; events were SHADOW_BATCH_CREATED, BATCH_SUSPENDED and BATCH_RESUMED at revisions 1, 2 and 3.

items.operation: Confirm an END candidate without command preconditions
items.evidence: The END command was rejected before persistence when Idempotency-Key and If-Match were absent.

items.operation: Confirm the END boundary and close the matching shadow batch
items.evidence: The matching ACTIVE batch became CLOSED_RAW at revision 2 with endTime=2026-07-12T08:29:40Z and the END candidate linked to the same batch ID.

items.operation: Replay the successful END confirmation with the same idempotency key
items.evidence: Idempotent-Replay=true returned the original CLOSED_RAW revision 2 response without another state event or audit.

items.operation: Directly verify END evidence, raw closure, ordered events and audits
items.evidence: State was CLOSED_RAW|2; START and END evidence each persisted once; events were SHADOW_BATCH_CREATED then END_BOUNDARY_CONFIRMED; audits included BATCH_CLOSED_RAW.

items.operation: Confirm a second START candidate while the same line already has an open batch
items.evidence: The line-level advisory lock and V4 partial unique index kept exactly one ACTIVE/SUSPENDED batch; the second candidate remained PENDING and the failed command left no idempotency row.

persistenceVerification.rejectionState: REJECTED|2|acceptance-user|现场确认该边界为流量波动误判
persistenceVerification.idempotencyCountNote: The actual test assertion is 1, not 2. The successful command and same-key replay share one row; the stale-revision command uses a new key but its transaction rolls back on 409, so it leaves no persistent row.
persistenceVerification.cleanup: After each test, targeted DELETE statements remove only rows belonging to the dynamic tenant marker, including the seeded rule and topology versions.

limitations: This is only the BPI Phase 1 shadow-batch vertical slice and is not a full Phase 1 production acceptance.
Kafka listener, duplicate delivery and DLQ were tested with a local embedded broker; the target three-broker cluster remains blocked by host disk capacity.
Flink logic and deterministic replay are covered separately, but target-cluster event-time, checkpoint and recovery acceptance remains blocked by host disk capacity.
The candidate payload came from an acceptance replay and not from a real IoT or JetLinks source.
Browser START/END confirmation, rejection and batch suspend/resume were exercised against the deterministic simulator; browser-to-PostgreSQL target acceptance is still pending.
No WOM, QCS or WMS write was executed; wmsStatus=NOT_REQUESTED is expected for this slice.
Acceptance JWTs use a short-lived HS256 internal test secret; production JWKS/asymmetric signing and key rotation remain pending.
Local PostgreSQL 16.13 ran in an isolated Docker network; this does not replace target-host Compose deployment acceptance.
Production deployment, concurrency load, fault injection, backup restore and soak testing remain out of scope.
